dedupe_keys.name: sncf open data portal sncf reseau and sncf voyageurs data

description: The SNCF open data portal is the catalogue of the French national railway group and currently lists 166 datasets. SNCF Réseau publishes the infrastructure: the list of bridges carrying or crossing the rail network (10,257 records), the line geometries of the national rail network (1,638 records), nominal maximum line speeds, tunnels, earthworks, footbridges and a 3D point cloud. Operators publish station lists, timetables, Transilien GTFS feeds, monthly TGV punctuality, station footfall and passenger and freight traffic series since 1841. Coverage is France. Access: free CSV, JSON and GeoJSON exports and an Opendatasoft API, with most infrastructure sets under the Open Database License; licences vary by dataset. Caveats: some infrastructure tables have not been refreshed for years (the bridge list was last modified in 2022), and asset attributes are limited to identifiers, locations and basic types. It supports rail network topology, bridge and tunnel exposure analysis, timetable-based service modelling and cascading failure studies, and complements the Mobility Database and the other national rail portals catalogued here.
